# MyOwnFreeHost API Documentation

### (Unofficial) API documentation for the MyOwnFreeHost hosting platform.

If you find any errors throughout this API reference or know of any API endpoints or wrappers that aren’t listed, please make an issue or join the [iFastNet Community Discord server](https://github.com/Wallvon/MOFH-API-Docs/issues/new) and ping `robe.rt`.
